INTRODUCTION.HEADING: Let's work together
INTRODUCTION.BIO: I'm a passionate full stack developer based in Paris, France. I build complete products, from modern web interfaces to servers, business software (Odoo) and automation, and I enjoy solving concrete problems for different industries and niches. I'm also interested in AI, open source and project management.
INTRODUCTION.CONTACT_INTRO: I would love to hear from you. Whether it is a project, job opportunity, or just a chat.

PROJECTS.TITLE: My Projects
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: These projects showcase my expertise in full stack development, business software and automation, from my own products to training projects. Each one demonstrates different skills and modern web technologies.

PROJECT_REEFOFFICE.TITLE: ReefOffice
PROJECT_REEFOFFICE.STACK: SvelteKit | Docker | Nextcloud | PostgreSQL | Private AI
PROJECT_REEFOFFICE.DESCRIPTION: My SaaS product: a managed private back office for small businesses. Files, document management, CRM, invoicing, automation and private AI run on a dedicated EU server for each customer, deployed, secured and backed up for them.

PROJECT_ROBIN4CONSULTING.TITLE: Robin4consulting
PROJECT_ROBIN4CONSULTING.DESCRIPTION: My consulting platform, built with Odoo: robin4consulting.com presents three services, each with its own site – germany.robin4consulting.com (relocating and setting up a business in Germany), it.robin4consulting.com (independent IT for freelancers and small businesses) and coaching.robin4consulting.com (coaching for founders). Trilingual, with pricing, contact forms and online booking.

PROJECT_JOIN.TITLE: Join
PROJECT_JOIN.DESCRIPTION: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. A collaborative project management tool with drag-and-drop functionality.

PROJECT_POLLO.TITLE: El Pollo Loco
PROJECT_POLLO.DESCRIPTION: Jump-and-Run game based on an object-oriented approach. Features include character movement, collision detection, and enemy AI.

PROJECT_POKEDEX.TITLE: Pokedex
PROJECT_POKEDEX.DESCRIPTION: Pokedex App using REST API to fetch all Pokemon data from the PokeAPI. Includes search functionality and detailed Pokemon information.
